title: Brian Daboll’s Cam Ward trickery didn’t sway Titans from taking QB with No. 1 pick

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Brian Daboll’s Cam Ward trickery didn’t sway Titans from taking QB with No. 1 pick
sources.description: Before Brian Daboll was in full-bloom love with Jaxson Dart, he tried to con the Titans into letting Cam Ward slip into his hands with the Giants.
